review.method: manual visual transcription with arithmetic reconciliation

notes: The printed negative line Discount BCA 15% is a receipt-wide discount, not a purchased menu item; 29,090 + 113,636 + 86,363 - 34,363 = 194,726 (printed Net Total). TAX 20,446 is added after service 9,736; 10% of their combined 204,462 base rounds to 20,446, but rate is not printed. Original image already obscures the merchant/header; do not infer a merchant.

taxability.evidence: Printed TAX Rp20,446 is 10% (rounded) of the printed Net Total Rp194,726 plus Srv Ch Rp9,736; all three printed menu items contribute to this aggregate food-and-drink tax base. This is arithmetic evidence from the receipt, not an individually printed item tax code.
